ogTitle: Where to Stay in Bophut–Fisherman's Village, Koh Samui
ogDesc: The best hotels in Bophut–Fisherman's Village by budget.
intro: Bophut is a north-coast district with a clear identity of its own. Its heart is Fisherman's Village — a row of old Sino-Portuguese wooden shophouses turned into restaurants, cafés, bars and shops right by the sea. Friday evenings bring a lively Walking Street market. Bophut Beach stretches out facing Koh Phangan across the water, with calm, shallow water better suited to relaxing than to active swimming. The real draw is the walkable eat-drink-stroll atmosphere, plus being the closest of the island's well-known areas to the airport. It works well for couples, families and anyone who wants the sea without Chaweng's intensity. The trade-offs are a beach that turns shallow and narrow at low tide, and far fewer late-night bars than Chaweng.

blocks.html: Short answer: Bophut sits on Koh Samui's north coast, anchored by Fisherman's Village — an old wooden walking street along the sea, packed with restaurants and bars. The beach is quieter than Chaweng, and it's about a 10–15 minute drive from the airport. It suits couples and anyone who likes to stroll, eat and people-watch in the evening. Rates start around ฿1,300 and climb to five-figure prices at the beachfront 5-star resorts.

items.name: ibis Samui Bophut
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Value · near airport · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The most affordable chain hotel in the area — rooms are small but clean and modern, and there are several pools that work for families. It's about a 15-minute walk or a short drive to Fisherman's Village. Reviews praise the value and friendly staff; breakfast is charged separately. A good fit for travellers who want a clean, budget-friendly base close to the airport.

items.name: Hacienda Fisherman's Village Koh Samui
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: In the village · walk everywhere · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small boutique right in the middle of Fisherman's Village — step out the door and you're among the restaurants and walking street. Rooms are nicely decorated with TVs and strong air-con, and the highlight is a rooftop pool overlooking Bophut bay and the surrounding islands. It's not on the beach but about a 5-minute walk to the sand. Reviews praise the location and attentive staff. Best for couples or anyone who wants to wake up in the heart of the eating-and-drinking strip.

items.name: The Waterfront Boutique Hotel
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Quiet · owner-run · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A seafront boutique at the quiet end of Fisherman's Village, about 150–200 metres' walk from the walking street. The owners live on-site and are known for warm, personal service. There's a pool facing the sea with views across to Koh Phangan, and rooms are clean with good hot water. Reviews repeatedly mention the view and the friendliness. The beach out front isn't the island's best for swimming, but for a calm atmosphere within walking distance of the restaurants, it fits nicely.

items.name: Zazen Boutique Resort & Spa
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Couples · spa and calm · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A beachfront boutique resort on Bophut Beach built around a romantic, private feel, with contemporary Thai styling set in green gardens. It has a spa, a beachside pool and a restaurant that reviews praise for breakfast and sea views. Being small, it gives guests close attention, and it scores especially well with couples. Ideal for honeymooners or anyone wanting a quiet beachfront stay with a good spa, within walking distance of Fisherman's Village.

items.name: Hansar Samui Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Sea-view rooms · service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star beachfront resort on Bophut Beach with 74 rooms, nearly all with sea views and oversized balconies — some with an outdoor tub on the terrace. The standout is the service, which reviews mention again and again, alongside a beachside pool, a spa and a walkable location near Fisherman's Village. It rates highly on Tripadvisor. Best for couples wanting spacious sea-view rooms with five-star service in a walkable area.

items.name: NH Collection Samui Peace Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Beach bungalows · families · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A renovated beachfront resort on Bophut Beach under the NH Collection brand, with 122 rooms — mostly garden bungalows, some opening straight onto the sand, plus pool villas. There's a large outdoor pool, a seafront restaurant and activities like kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding. Reviews praise the beach location, the spacious bungalows and the breakfast. A solid choice for families or couples who want a beach bungalow within walking distance of the village.

items.name: Anantara Bophut Koh Samui Resort
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Luxury · gardens and spa · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star beachfront resort on Bophut Beach known for its lush gardens and lily ponds, with shaded, private architecture. It has a garden spa in standalone treatment suites, luxurious rooms set in generous grounds, and several restaurants. Fisherman's Village is a short drive or a beach walk away. Best for honeymooners and anyone wanting a luxurious, garden-calm beachfront resort on the island's north coast.

faq.q: Who is Bophut–Fisherman's Village best for?
faq.a: It suits couples, families and anyone who likes to stroll, eat and drink by the sea in a calmer setting than Chaweng. The heart of the area is Fisherman's Village, an old wooden street full of restaurants, cafés and bars, with a busy Walking Street market every Friday evening. If you want lots of late-night bars or a long beach for all-day swimming, Chaweng is a better match.

faq.q: Is Bophut Beach good for swimming?
faq.a: Bophut Beach is a quiet stretch of sand facing Koh Phangan across the water, with calm, shallow water that's better for sitting, paddling or letting kids wade than for deep swimming. At low tide some sections become shallow and narrow. If swimming is a priority, most people take a short drive to Chaweng or Lamai, which have deeper water and wider beaches.

faq.q: How far is Bophut from the airport and Chaweng?
faq.a: Samui airport is very close, about a 10–15 minute drive, which is a real plus for arrivals and departures. Chaweng — the island's main shopping and nightlife hub — is roughly 15–20 minutes away by car. There's no proper public transport on the island, so most people use songthaews (shared trucks), taxis, ride-hailing apps, or rent a scooter or car.
